info.name: Before You Dispatch API
info.description: Requests for before-you-dispatch-api, in the order a delivery happens. Run a folder top to bottom (or use Run collection): 'Create order' saves customerToken into a collection variable, so later requests pick it up automatically. Each request has tests that check the response. Endpoint details: API.md.
